response.answer: Make your yes contingent on a structured advance question-collection process: questions submitted ahead of time, written responses prepared and used to anchor the meeting, and a clear rule that unexpected legal/governance questions are deferred for a precise written follow-up rather than answered off the cuff. This is especially important with two rapid-fire questioners expected. The process is available at no extra cost through the board secretary. Your experience supports this: advance collection shortened a smooth meeting and helped pass the budget unamended, whereas an improvised legal answer in an open-floor session required a formal correction.
